programs.description: Nandakumar, a reporter, is assigned to cover the hapless plight of farmers at Pannakamkudi. Upon seeing their sufferings in person, he decides to help them.
Vishnu gets acquainted with Raghu during a trip and learns that he is rich and is returning home after 16 years. Then, Vishnu pushes Raghu into a ravine and goes to his house pretending to be him.
After his thesis gets rejected and he gets expelled from his college, the idealistic Sreekumar is left with no choice but to take up menial jobs in a pigsty.
Govindankutty faces several obstacles after he inherits an ancestral property which often results in hilarious situations.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
Seven friends work for an IT company and lead a seemingly easy-going life. However, each one of them is secretly dealing with personal issues related to love and family.
The life of Sunandha, a poor widow, turns around after she starts a kindergarten with the help of her silent admirer. But things become complicated because of a tragic event.
A family has to deal with the fact that the father, who is also the one that holds the family together, has developed Alzheimer's disease.

A young woman faces constant torment and oppression from her family, but remains resilient in her search for love and happiness.
A father's decision to remarry brings unexpected struggles as his son Sethumadhavan steps up to care for his half-sisters, navigating shifting family relationships.
Sridevi leads a peaceful and happy life with her husband, Balakrishnan, and his siblings. However, the family faces various adversities that challenge their bonding.
Though separated, a husband and wife still love each other but hide their true feelings out of fear of rejection. They are then forced to confront their emotions or risk losing each other forever.
When the past of a middle-aged unmarried businessman confronts him, it affects his unusual romantic relationship with a younger girl.

When Anand visits Hyderabad, he encounters Sathyam, who operates an organisation aiding the underprivileged. Sathyam, swayed by Anand's vision, hands over the organisation's management to him.
